title: Brazil Election: Bolsonaro Surges in Poll as Supreme Court Crisis Weighs on Lula
title_cn: 巴西选举：最高法院危机给卢拉带来压力，博尔索纳罗民意调查激增
summary: Flávio Bolsonaro surged into a tie with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in a new poll, erasing a 4.5-point gap as a crisis inside Brazil’s Supreme Court weighs on the leftist leader’s reelection bid.

title: UAE Plans to Invest $46 Billion in Germany From AI to Energy
title_cn: 阿联酋计划向德国投资 460 亿美元，涉足人工智能和能源领域
summary: The United Arab Emirates plans to invest €40 billion ($46 billion) in Germany in sectors ranging from AI to energy and defense, as the Gulf country looks to deepen strategic partnerships across Europe.

title: Trump's $5,000 Dividend Offer Is a Gimmick, Says Beto O'Rourke
title_cn: 贝托·奥罗克 (Beto O'Rourke) 表示，特朗普提出的 5,000 美元股息是一个噱头
summary: Beto O’Rourke said President Donald Trump’s promise to pay American adults $5,000 apiece is a "gimmick" and will never be paid. The former US representative from Texas says Republicans can't offer voters real change. He also talks about how Democratic Senate candidate James Talarico can win his race in Texas. O'Rourke speaks to Bloomberg's Julie Fine and Kailey Leinz in Dallas. (Source: Bloomberg)
